m: भाज् mfn. (mostly ifc.; exceptionally with gen.) sharing or participating in, entitled to, possessing, enjoying, perceiving, feeling, sensible of, devoted to, intent upon, Br. &c. &c.
forming a part of, belonging to, RPrāt.
joined or connected with, liable to, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
occupying, inhabiting, frequenting, dwelling or living in or on Kāv.; MārkP.
going or resorting to, falling into, seeking, Ragh.; Kir.
revering, worshipping, Bhag.; Ragh.
what is due, duty, concern (= कर्तव्य), Bhaṭṭ.
भाज् भाजन. See col. 1.
a: भाज् — {c10c} U. To divide, distribute; see भज् caus.

भाज् — a. (Usually at the end of comp.) 1 Sharing or participating in, liable to; पाप˚ Ku. 5. 83; दोष˚ guilty. --2 Having, enjoying, possessing, obtaining; सुख˚, रिक्थ˚. --3 Entitled to. --4 Feeling, experiencing, being sensible of. --5 Devoting oneself to. --6 Living in, inhabiting, dwelling in; as in कुहरभाज्, दरीभाज् &c. --7 Going or resorting to, seeking. --8 Worshipping. --9 Falling to the lot of. --10 What must be done, a duty (कर्तव्य); Bk. 3. 21.

m: भाजा f. = वक्र-यष्टि, Gaṇar. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 42).

s: strI, (BAjyate iti । BAja + karmmaRi GaY । BAja + “jAnapadakuRqagORasTalaBAjanAgeti .” 4 । 1 । 42 । iti NIz .) aYjanaviSezaH । anyatra BAjA । iti strItyawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥
v: strI॰ BAja--karmaRi GaY ni॰ NIp । BfzwavyaYjanaBede । anyatra BAjA । si॰ kO॰ ।
m: भाजी f. rice-gruel (= श्राणा), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 42 (= पङ्क-व्यञ्जन-विशेष, Vop., Sch.)

s: t ka pfTakkftyAm । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adantacurA॰-para॰-saka॰-sew .) avaBAjat DanaM BrAtfvargaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: pfTakkaraRe, ada॰ cu॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । BAjayati te avaBAjat ta ।

m: भाजक् ind. (g. चादि) quickly, swiftly, L.
भाजक m. (fr. Caus.) a divisor (in arithm.), Col.
भाजनी-भूत mfn. (ifc.) one who has become a vessel for or who has obtained, Kathās.; Lalit.

s: klI, (BAjyate iti । BAja pfTakkaraRe + lyuw .) pAtram । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 33 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 111 । 102 । “rAjataM BAjanaM hftvA kapotaH saMprajAyate ॥”) yogyam । iti medinI । ne, 101 ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 34 । 205 । “tasmAjjitAtmA rAjA syAdyuktadaRqo viSezavit । prajAnurAgAdevaM hi sa BavedBAjanaM SriyaH ॥”) “yaH saMvAdayate nityaM yo'BivAdAMstitikzati । yaSca tapto na tapati dfQaM so'rTasya BAjanam ॥” iti matsyapurARam ॥ AQakaparimARam । iti vEdyakapariBAzA ॥
v: na॰ Bajyate'nena BAja--lyuw । 1 pAtre amaraH । 2 ATAre 3 yogye ca medi॰ । 4 AQakaparimARaBede vEdyakam ।
m: भाजन n. (fr. Caus.) sharing, division (in arithm.), Col.
भाजन mf(आ)n. (ifc.) sharing or participating in, entitled or relating or belonging to, Br. &c. &c.
भाजन n. ‘partaker of’, a recipient, receptacle, (esp.) a vessel, pot, plate, cup, &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.
भाजन n. (with gen. or ifc. with f(आ). ), a place or person in which anything is collected or in whom any quality is conspicuous, any fit object or clever or deserving person, ib. (cf. पात्र)
भाजन n. the act of representing, representation (˚नेन ind. with gen. in the place of; ifc. a representative, deputy, substitute, serving for, equivalent to), Br.; GṛS.
भाजन n. a partic. measure (= an Āḍhaka = 14 Palas), ŚārṅgS.
भाजन m. N. of a man
भाजन m. pl. his descendants g. बिदादि.
a: भाजनं — [भाज्येतऽनेन भाज्-ल्युट्] 1 Sharing, dividing. --2 Division. (in arith.). --3 A vessel, pot, cup, plate; पुष्पभाजनं Ś. 4; R. 5. 22. --4 (Fig.) A receptacle, recipient, repository; स श्रियो भाजनं नरः Pt. 1. 243; कल्याणानां त्वमसि महसां भाजनं विश्वपूर्ते Māl. 1. 3; ऐहिकस्य सुखस्याभाजनमयं जनः Dk.; U. 3. 15; M. 5. 8. --5 A fit or deserving person, a fit object or person; भवादृशा एव भवंति भाजनान्युपदेशानां K. 108. --6 Representation. --7 A measure equal to 64 palas.

k.v: कुतूः कृत्तेः स्नेहपात्रं सैवाल्पा कुतुपः पुमान्. सर्वमावपनं भाण्डं पात्रामत्रं च भाजनम्.।

m: भाजन—चारिक v.l. (or w.r.) for -वारिक, q.v.
भाजन—लोक m. (with Buddhists) the world of inanimate things (opp. to सत्त्व-ल्˚, q.v.), Dharmas. 89.
भाजन—ता f. (ifc.) the being a vessel for, possession of BhP.
भाजन—त्व n. the being a fit vessel for (gen.), merit, worthiness, Mālav.
भाजन—वारिक m. a vessel-keeper, Divyāv. (cf. -चारिका).
भाजन—वत् mfn. a word used to explain भद्र, Nir. iv, 10 &c.
भाजनेन ind., with gen. in the place of; ifc. a representative, deputy, substitute, serving for, equivalent to
भाजयु mfn. (fr. Caus.) sharing with others, generous, liberal, RV.
भाजिन् mfn. (ifc.) sharing, participating in ChUp.; Kum.
connected with, Kām.

s: tri, (BAjyate smeti । BAja + kta .) pfTakkftam । viBaktam । iti BAjaDAtoHkarmmaRi ktapratyayena nizpannam ॥ (BAve + kta .) BAge, klI ॥
v: tri॰ BAji--karmaRi kta । 1 pfTakkfte । 2 Bakte ca ।
m: भाजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) shared, divided, Sūryas.
distributed, portioned, W.
भाजित n. a share, portion, ib.
a: भाजित — a. Shared, divided. --तं A share, portion.

s: tri, BAgArham । BAjanIyam । iti BAjaDAtoH karmmaRi yapratyayena nizpannam ॥
v: tri॰ Bajyate viBajyate Baja--karmaRi Ryat । viBajanIye “BAjyo haraH SuDyati yadguRaH syAdi” ti lIlAvatI ।
m: भाज्य mfn. to be shared or distributed &c.
(in arithm.) to be divided, as subst. = a dividend, Siddhāntaś.
a: भाज्य — a. [भज्-ण्यत्] Divisible. --ज्यं 1 A portion, share. --2 An inheritance. --3 (In arith.) The dividend.
